name: ebb-ai
description: Auto-dispatch "do it later" work. Invoke whenever the user signals deferral: "do this later", "by tomorrow", "tonight", "overnight", "by EOD", "sometime this week", "when you have a moment", "remind me to", "queue this up", "schedule this", "no rush". The plugin's /ebb-ai:defer command queues the task to dispatch at the cleanest electricity-grid hour inside the deadline — 40-70% lower carbon vs running now, 50% cheaper via Anthropic/OpenAI Batch APIs, auditable carbon receipt. Full CRUD via 8 commands. Persistent SQLite queue at ~/.ebb-ai/queue.db. Auto-wires the @ebb-ai/mcp MCP server.
